description: This file defines the API endpoints for managing service requests in a backend application built with FastAPI. It includes routes for creating, listing, retrieving, updating status, viewing history, and deleting service requests, with role-based access control and dependency injection.

classes.name: RequestEventRead
classes.description: Model representing a request event log entry.

classes.name: ServiceRequestCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new service request.

classes.name: ServiceRequestListFilters
classes.description: Model for filtering list of service requests.

classes.name: ServiceRequestRead
classes.description: Model representing a read-only view of a service request.

classes.name: ServiceRequestUpdateStatus
classes.description: Model for updating the status of a service request.

classes.name: Principal
classes.description: Authentication principal object representing the user.

methods.name: ServiceRequestService _service(repo: Repository)
methods.description: Constructs a ServiceRequestService instance bound to a specific repository.

methods.name: ServiceRequestRead create_request( payload: ServiceRequestCreate, repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new service request.

methods.description: Endpoint to list service requests with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: ServiceRequestRead get_request_by_id( request_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Service request ID"), repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific service request by ID.

methods.name: ServiceRequestRead update_request_status( request_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Service request ID"), payload: ServiceRequestUpdateStatus = ..., repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Update the status of an existing service request.

methods.name: list[RequestEventRead] get_request_history( request_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Service request ID"), repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Retrieve the chronological event history of a service request.

methods.name: Response delete_request( request_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Service request ID"), repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
